scope: Full key-schedule concept article only; no completion claim for AES, DES, PRESENT, TEA, RC5 or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 key-schedule 这一概念：主密钥到轮密钥的确定性转换、AES 与 DES 的两种结构、弱密钥、熵和侧信道边界，以及它与 KDF 的区别；不把 AES、DES、PRESENT、TEA、RC5 或具体算法并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the key-schedule concept: deterministic master-key-to-round-key conversion, the AES and DES structures, weak keys, entropy and side-channel boundaries, and the distinction from a KDF. It does not absorb AES, DES, PRESENT, TEA, RC5 or a specific algorithm.
